description: Through ADODB.Connection (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0, Mode adModeRead, Data Source set through Connection.Properties) on r-sort-3-corpus-accdb: reads the ID sequences of ORDER BY K, ORDER BY K DESC, ORDER BY K, ID and the equal-K pair self-join of T; then opens table T as an adOpenKeyset adLockReadOnly adCmdTableDirect recordset, sets Index IX_K, and for a small sample of each corpus group runs Seek with adSeekFirstEQ, adSeekLastEQ and adSeekAfterEQ, reading EOF and ID. Asks whether the ADO provider's public order, equality and seek agree with DAO, as a separate client lane.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: SELECT ID FROM T ORDER BY K
SELECT ID FROM T ORDER BY K DESC
SELECT ID FROM T ORDER BY K, ID
